column6: A relaxed, somewhat slow-paced theme with a distinct, cold, and crystalline feel.
A calm, mysterious, and wintery theme slightly reminiscent of the Alt Underground theme.
It vaguely resembles a Christmas song but is more upbeat and uses an electric guitar with a heavy distortion applied giving it a metal feel to the track.
A calm and relaxing track which shifts between what resembles uplifting trance music and fantasy music.
It has a "crystalline" and rather ominous sound to it.
Arranged by . It is an upbeat, electronic remix of "The E.F.S. Of Winter" from Don't Starve Together. E.F.S. stands for Epic Fight Song.
